content: To ascertain the relevance of the different layers of content clusters found in the MS analysis, we examined in detail the five levels of resolution presented in Figure 3 . For each level, we prepared word clouds (lemmatised for increased intelligibility), as well as a Sankey diagram and a contingency table linking content clusters (i.e., graph communities) with the hand-coded categories externally assigned by an operator. We note again that this comparison was only done a posteriori, i.e., the external categories were not used in our text analysis. The results are shown in Figures 4 – 6 (and Supplementary Figures S1 – S2 ) for all levels.
